statement: A diagnostic, one run at commit ede0176b10bb, judging no target: the sampled user-mode cycles (cycles:u) of the price column's decode, store_decode/add_price, recorded only inside column_decode_bench's timed passes, as shares by group of functions. Shares of samples, not times; no time is reported.
input: store_decode/add_price on the slice 12302019-open, the timed throughput passes only (perf's control FIFOs)

build.note: the bench preset's build with -gline-tables-only added to every compile and link through the clang driver's CCC_OVERRIDE_OPTIONS, so no CMake variable differs; bench/column_decode_bench's .text is byte for byte the measured build's

largest.symbol: tick_store::codec::read_patches(tick_store::codec::ByteCursor&, unsigned long, unsigned long, unsigned int, tick_store::

lost_samples_at_most: 0.1% of the samples kept and lost

inclusive.note: null: under the report's limit, or not called

group_table.rule: a symbol goes to the first group with a pattern that matches it: name patterns are matched from the start of the function's qualified name, its return type and parameters dropped; dso against the shared object; level against perf's [k] or [.] mark

groups.name: kernel_addresses
groups.what: samples perf placed at a kernel address though only user mode was counted

groups.name: zstd
groups.what: zstd inflate and its entropy decoders

groups.name: pfor_block_decode
groups.what: PFOR block decode: header, scale and patches, and what is inlined into it

groups.name: unpack_kernels
groups.what: the unpack, delta and add kernels of every kernel set

groups.name: codec_column_decode
groups.what: the codec's column driver: block headers, value checks, reserving

groups.name: store_column_decode
groups.what: the store's column decode: its block decoder, range check and append

groups.name: containers
groups.what: the standard library's vectors, strings and hash tables, as compiled into the binary: growth, copies, assignment

groups.name: memory
groups.what: allocation and copies, where the C library's symbols resolve

groups.name: libc
groups.what: the C library, its addresses unresolved

groups.name: bench_harness
groups.what: the benchmark's own loop and checks

groups.name: unmatched
groups.what: symbols no pattern above matches, kept apart and never spread over the groups

commands: perf record --no-buildid-cache -e cycles:u --user-callchains --call-graph dwarf\,16384 -F 4000 --delay=-1 --control=fifo:ctl\,ack -o price-decode.data -- column_decode_bench --slice=12302019-open.itch --expect-sha256=6ef692fc1f1478614aace94dfa50cdcdad4cfa835dc5b228cfd25339bd0fdb0a --expect-messages=6125294 --case=store_decode/add_price --report=report.json --perf-control=ctl --perf-ack=ack --benchmark_color=false
